purpose: Define the minimum bounded official TWSE suspension/resumption negative-completeness evidence required before a real exact-window witness may receive CLEAR_NO_ACTION.

blockingSemantic.currentPositiveOnlyLimitation: absenceCertifiesNoEvent=false; announcement-list absence cannot certify a clean window
blockingSemantic.currentTwtaWuLimitation: Existing System2 consumers deliberately emit absenceCertifiesNoSuspension=false / allHistoryCompletenessCertified=false. That conservative all-history state must not be silently overwritten.

observedSemantics: TWSE labels the page as historical information query for trading-halt securities.
The query exposes an explicit data period.
The query supports security code or all listed securities.
TWSE states the database contains information from 2011-10-03 onward.
officialPrimaryEvidence.interpretation: This supports engineering a bounded exact-window completeness contract. It does not by itself promote the JSON machine endpoint or any empty result to COMPLETE.

minimumPhysicalProducerSequence: Obtain the exact selected RAW PIT replay window first; use its firstSelectedDate/lastSelectedDate as the bounded suspension query interval. Do not hard-code a generic annual range.
Fetch TWTAWU from the official TWSE endpoint for that exact interval, preserving request URL/parameters, observedAt, raw-body hash and source identity.
Require accepted HTTP/body/schema/status semantics and the expected symbol/suspension/resumption field contract.

Prove response completeness for the requested bounded interval. When the JSON response lacks an authoritative total/range-completeness indicator, require an independent same-query official representation or other canonical completeness proof; do not infer completeness merely from HTTP 200 or an empty data array.
Confirm the witness date window is fully after the official database history start.
Normalize positive halt/resumption rows with half-open interval semantics; preserve conflicts and open intervals fail-closed.
For the witness symbol, distinguish EVENT_PRESENT, NO_SUSPENSION_IN_COMPLETE_BOUNDED_WINDOW, and SUSPENSION_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN.
Only NO_SUSPENSION_IN_COMPLETE_BOUNDED_WINDOW may contribute TWSE=COMPLETE negative suspension coverage for CLEAR_NO_ACTION.
Bind the bounded suspension receipt digest into the corporate-action completeness receipt/sourceEvidenceRefs used by the continuity receipt.
A post-decision observation may be used only under the explicitly allowed historical/source-availability semantics; do not backdate a later observation into the original decision clock.
Keep the entire producer read-only/artifact-only; no D1 historical mutation is required.
requiredCorporateActionCompanionSources: TWSE_EX_RIGHT_DIVIDEND_ACTUAL / TWT49U exact historical actual-result range
TWSE_CAPITAL_REDUCTION_REFERENCE / TWTAUU exact historical actual-result range
TWSE_PAR_VALUE_CHANGE_REFERENCE / TWTB8U exact historical actual-result range
failClosedRules: Positive-only announcement-list absence is not NO_SUSPENSION.
HTTP 200 alone is not bounded completeness.
Empty TWTAWU data without a proven bounded query contract is UNKNOWN.
Any positive relevant suspension interval overlapping the replay window prevents CLEAR_NO_ACTION unless the exact symbol-session/replay semantics are reconciled.
RAW + ADJUSTED_CONTINUITY remains prohibited for the first NC-T01 witness.
Do not require TPEx parity or all-history TWTAWU completeness for the first TWSE witness.
Do not require annual D1/R2 rerun or write quota for this read-only evidence gate.
acceptanceCriteria: One real TWSE exact-session-ready witness uses the exact replay-window interval, not a hand-picked generic interval.
TWTAWU bounded response completeness is machine-verifiable for that interval.
The witness suspension classification is source-honest and immutable.
All three TWSE corporate-action historical actual-result families are exact-range/parser/revision complete for the same replay interval.
Corporate-action completeness receipt reaches eventCoverageComplete=true and suspensionCoverageByExchange.TWSE=COMPLETE without fabricated evidence.
The resulting CLEAR_NO_ACTION receipt is hash-bound to exact replayHash/sourceHistoryHash/session hashes/source evidence and observed no later than the allowed evidence cut.
No System1 runtime, final-selection, live-push, capital or order authority is introduced.
exactNext: DATA_LANE implements or composes a read-only exact-window TWTAWU bounded-completeness probe using existing official source/parser utilities where possible.

Run it against a real exact-session-ready TWSE witness, preferably 1101 only as a candidate; if any required evidence is incomplete, fail closed and try another truthfully ready witness rather than assuming cleanliness.
Compose the three existing TWSE exact-range corporate-action source parses plus bounded suspension receipt into the corporate-action completeness receipt.
If COMPLETE, emit the first real buildNct01TwseClearNoActionPromotionReceiptV0_1 receipt; otherwise preserve CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN.
BUILD_LANE consumes only the real receipt in the artifact-only NC-T01 runner and emits the typed end-to-end hash chain.
